title: One pass closes a stale draft and archives its idle lane together
why: The stale-draft pass closes only drafts new to the build's list, and the idle-lanes pass keeps a lane that holds an open PR, so about 350 drafts listed since 23:41 CST Nov 12 stay open (plans/stale-drafts-2026-11-13.md, sixth pass: 352 listed, 0 closed).
note: Waits on Cockpit item 688: a joint pass (recommended), b fix only stale-draft-reads-runner-holds, c leave it. 09:15 CST Nov 13: settled by decision stalled-steps (owner 16:44 CST Nov 11: triage closes the build's stale drafts once, then at each batch); item 688 closed as a stood pick. Owner 09:12 CST asked for a mechanical fix. Build: merge --idle-lanes prints one close-and-archive line for a draft over 12 h whose step is done or missing and whose lane is idle over 12 h; at each batch runner 10 pushes archive/<branch>, closes the draft, archives the lane. The first run clears the backlog. Red first: a fixture pair prints the line; a lane with a live step does not. Undo: owner says so. Owner-confirmed 09:16 CST Nov 13 (ruling stale-draft-joint-pass): ruling p of decision stalled-steps plus option a, one joint close-and-archive line in merge --idle-lanes. Lane handed #3142 (bbf3a0142) to runner 10 (coordinator 10:44 CST Nov 13). Lane pick, under today's hold: a stale draft with no head sha gets no joint line. Notes for the notes file: names_step misses lane/<step> branches (low harm, since the archive guard still checks); the twin of on_lane_form could move to shared_names.py; the records rule misses the singular "record"; merge's summary tail gives no close-then-archive order. The publisher fields are on step stale-draft-reads-runner-holds (lane live-publisher-tracked, #3147).
